choice.basis: The plotted line is the evidence source. It starts at the 1880 tick just below the 1,000 y-axis mark and ends at the 1891 tick near the 3,000 mark (approx. 2,900). The 1891 endpoint is physically higher on the chart than the 1880 startpoint, indicating a substantial increase in new tourists over the review period. Although the chart title reads 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists,' the visual data contradicts this label. The task asks to choose a route for the 'tourism operations trend' based on the dashboard evidence. The measured change is a significant growth (from ~1,000 to ~2,900).
